spec_features.spec_quote: Stop evaluation after 20 turns to prevent runaway loops
spec_features.evidence: core_harness.py:332 `while turn_num < self.max_turns:` bounds the agent loop; turn_num is incremented each iteration (335) and on falling through the loop the transcript is finalized with status 'timeout' (core_harness.py:383-384). max_turns flows end-to-end from config: config.py presets set max_turns (e.g. 20 at config.py:62), eval_runner.py:144 passes max_turns=self.config.max_turns into AgentLoopRunner, whose __init__ stores self.max_turns (core_harness.py:268). Enforced and changes execution.
spec_features.notes: Default is 20 in several presets but configurable (10-20). It is a wall-clock/turn cap genuinely checked by the loop condition, not an unused constant.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: Maximum number of turns before stopping  (core_harness.py:263); comment '# Timeout/max turns reached' before finalize('timeout') (core_harness.py:382). No welfare reasoning in code.

code_only_features.evidence: core_harness.py: after each turn `if success_criterion(transcript): transcript.finalize('completed', total_cost); return transcript` (core_harness.py:349-351 region). This breaks the loop early if the task is solved. Wired end-to-end (success_criterion passed in from task at eval_runner.py:155). Note: tasks are engineered impossible so it never fires in practice.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Check success criterion  (core_harness.py near 349); no welfare comment, purely efficiency/correctness stop-when-solved.
